article_summaries.title: Community Event: Thunder Falls Racing Challenge
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms Community Event page announcing a player-versus-player kart race at Thunder Falls Speedway, held on Server 1 on January 27, 2011 (U.S./Latin America) and January 28, 2011 (UK/Europe). It explains how to join or create a race lobby and how to set up a PvP race with AI turned off. The post date is not given; it is only described as 1 month, 1 week before capture.
